title: Add shared CompanyMetadata data source for report layouts
summary: A shared CompanyMetadata data source is now available for report layouts to bind company information, eliminating the need for each report to manually code Company Information fields.
key_points: ReportManagement subscribes to the GetCompanyMetadata business event and populates a shared company block with name, address, contact details, bank information, and identifiers
New Company Metadata Builder codeunit provides typed setters to centralize wire keys and avoid hand-written key strings
Company display name uses CompanyProperty.DisplayName() to align with how ReportRequest is built
Empty Company Information fields produce present-but-empty values in the data source
Tests-Report coverage validates values, captions, display-name logic, empty-safe behavior, and address repeater functionality
quote: Adds a shared CompanyMetadata data source so report layouts can bind one shared company block instead of each report hand-coding Company Information fields.
